svg.title: Output length counts valid kernel starting positions
svg.desc: A length-3 kernel on a length-7 input with stride 1 has five starting indices, 0 through 4. One padding cell on each side makes a length-9 computation region with seven starting indices, 0 through 6. The extra two from padding differs from the extra one used to count all starting positions.
svg.text: Output length counts valid kernel starting positions
Only the width is shown. Apply the same count to the height.
Small numbers label indices in this region.
Small numbers label indices in this region.
The computation region grows by 2 cells.
We also compute at starting index 0.
stride=1: output length = input length + 2×padding − kernel length + 1
Conditions: dilation=1, equal padding on both sides. The original tensor keeps its shape.
